name: Eden Smith
dateNote: He was baptized in 1831; section 75 names him in January 1832 and section 80 in March 1832.
importance: Section 75 pairs him with Micah B. Welton. Section 80 then names him as Stephen Burnett’s companion, though illness delayed their preaching. He was disfellowshipped in 1833 and rebaptized in 1834.
connections: His father was a John Smith, not Joseph Smith’s uncle of that name. His named companions are Micah B. Welton and Stephen Burnett.

sources.title: Eden Smith, Doctrine and Covenants Central

reviewNote: JSP person page not found by search; used D&C Central, which cites his journal and JSP documents: born 1806; baptized 1831; disfellowshipped 2 July 1833; rebaptized 27 Aug. 1834 by William E. McLellin; died 7 Dec. 1851, Vermillion County, Indiana. The father-not-uncle point is inferred because D&C Central places the father in Indiana in 1833.
